note: The vulnerable input reaches MLE parent-response handling through the radio-receive-done fuzz target.
UDP dispatch removes the UDP header and forwards the attacker-controlled packet payload into the registered MLE receive handler.
The packet is parsed as an MLE Parent Response and routed to the parent-response parser.

The response TLV length is attacker-controlled within the parsed message, but the code compares that many bytes against the fixed-size stored challenge, creating the out-of-bounds read sink reported by ASAN.
